read_sources: canonical WEB Micah coordinates and text
not_read: state or completion artifacts for Mic

non_authority_statement: Candidate literary and structural evidence only. Every boundary is LOW and deferred_human_or_external_ai. No theology, canon, authorship, date, historicity, chronology, ethics, identity, fulfillment, covenant system, preferred witness, preferred reading, preferred translation, source tradition, graph, retrieval, reviewed-gold, or promotion authority.
routing_principle: Prefer larger coherent rhetorical movements; preserve superscription/theophany, lament-wordplay, woe, prophet dispute, remnant promise, full indictments, Zion/nations, daughter-Zion, ruler/remnant, lawsuit/disputation, communal lament/confession, shepherd prayer, and closing hymn. Markers and original-language observations are evidence only.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: superscription, theophanic summons, city judgment, and place-name lament
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: The opening vision frame moves through cosmic descent and city judgment into enacted lament.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: woe, land-loss sentence, prophet dispute, and remnant-breaker promise
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Plotting, contested speech, and promise form one indictment-dispute-promise complex.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: rulers, prophets, chiefs, and priests indictment
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Repeated hear summons and role contrasts culminate in Zion plowing.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: Zion and nations, remnant, daughter-Zion, ruler, deliverance, and purification sequence
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Restoration, siege, ruler, remnant, enemy, and purification movements remain mutually framing.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: lawsuit summons, recital, disputation, response, and city indictment
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: Hearing summons and recital frame offering questions, response, and city charges.

macro_parent_alternatives.form: communal lament, confession, enemy address, restoration, shepherd prayer, and hymn
macro_parent_alternatives.preservation_reason: First-person voice progresses from desolation through confidence and prayer to final praise.

global_hot_zones.issue: Superscription and hear summons admit two opening routes.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain title separately and 1:2 with theophany; preserve 1:1-16 parent.
Preserve cumulative lament; infer no geography, chronology, or lexical certainty.

global_hot_zones.issue: Speaker ownership and quoted speech are ambiguous.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep the dispute whole; assign no final speaker identity.

global_hot_zones.issue: Speaker and breaker identity are contested.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep gathering and breaker imagery together; decide no identity or fulfillment.
Use present form only; decide no authorship, direction, chronology, or source.

global_hot_zones.issue: Daughter-Zion, siege, ruler, and Assyria admit seams; versification differs near 5:1.
global_hot_zones.handling: Preserve coherent strophes and alternatives; decide no ruler identity or fulfillment.

global_hot_zones.issue: Ruler-origin wording, pronouns, and later reuse create pressure.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep ruler through peace together; prefer no witness or fulfillment system.

global_hot_zones.issue: Offering escalation and response are often detached.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep questions and answer together; decide no sacrificial or theological system.

global_hot_zones.issue: Confession, enemy address, rebuilding, and nations admit multiple seams.
global_hot_zones.handling: Retain coherent address and restoration units inside the larger parent.

global_hot_zones.issue: Prayer, answer, nations, and hymn can split or merge.
global_hot_zones.handling: Keep petition-response and hymn as two movements; decide no fulfillment.

units.title: Superscription concerning Samaria and Jerusalem
units.literary_form: prophetic superscription
units.deciding_marker: Word-event, named seer, reign list, and subject cities form the title before the hear summons.
units.rejected_alternative: Merging the title into the cosmic summons or using the reign list to settle date and authorship.
units.risk: authorship, date, historicity, city scope, and vision terminology

units.title: Hear summons, theophany, and city judgment
units.literary_form: cosmic summons and theophanic judgment oracle
units.deciding_marker: Hear address, divine witness, descent, melting landscape, cause question, and Samaria sentence complete the opening oracle.
units.rejected_alternative: Detaching the theophany from its city accusation or atomizing images of descent and melting.
units.risk: theophany, divine action, city identity, cult, violence, and fulfillment

units.title: Prophetic lament and place-name procession
units.literary_form: first-person lament with enacted mourning and place-name wordplay
units.deciding_marker: Therefore launches mourning; wound-to-Judah expands through a cumulative named-place chain and closes with exile mourning.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting each place or resolving Hebrew soundplay into certain English meanings and historical itinerary.
units.risk: speaker, geography, wordplay, translation, historical setting, and exile chronology

units.title: Woe to planners of seizure and land-loss lament
units.literary_form: woe indictment, corresponding sentence, and taunt-lament
units.deciding_marker: Woe names night planning and morning seizure; therefore announces disaster and culminates in bitter lament and lost allotment.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating offense from matching sentence or using land language to settle covenant and historical systems.
units.risk: property ethics, land theology, disaster, history, and covenant system

units.title: Prophetic speech dispute and dispossession charge
units.literary_form: quoted-speech dispute, rebuttal, indictment, expulsion, and false-prophet satire
units.deciding_marker: Do-not-prophesy speech opens an exchange; rebuttal, garment and household charges, departure command, and wine-prophet satire sustain it.
units.rejected_alternative: Assigning every line to a certain speaker or detaching the false-prophet caricature.
units.risk: speaker ambiguity, prophetic office, ethics, translation, exile, and satire

units.title: Gathered remnant and the breaker
units.literary_form: gathering promise with procession and breaker imagery
units.deciding_marker: Repeated gathering forms the flock image; breaking out, passing the gate, king, and divine lead complete the promise.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating gathering from procession or deciding speaker, breaker, king, sequence, or fulfillment.
units.risk: speaker, remnant, ruler identity, chronology, translation, and fulfillment

units.title: Rulers who consume the people
units.literary_form: hear summons, grotesque indictment, and unanswered-cry sentence
units.deciding_marker: Hear addresses rulers; knowing-justice question unfolds into body-consumption imagery and concludes with hidden-face response.
units.rejected_alternative: Atomizing the body catalogue or turning metaphor into historical identity.
units.risk: leadership, justice, violence imagery, divine response, and historical referents

units.title: Misleading prophets and the empowered countervoice
units.literary_form: prophetic indictment, darkness sentence, shame scene, and first-person contrast
units.deciding_marker: Formula against prophets leads from bite/peace through night and shame to but-as-for-me countervoice.
units.rejected_alternative: Detaching 3:8 to settle inspiration mechanics or prophetic identity.
units.risk: prophetic office, payment, inspiration, Spirit language, speaker, and theology

units.title: Leaders, priests, and prophets bring Zion's plowing
units.literary_form: renewed hear indictment and climactic verdict
units.deciding_marker: Hear gathers rulers, builders, judges, priests, and prophets; therefore delivers the Zion/Jerusalem/temple-mount reversal.
units.rejected_alternative: Detaching 3:12 as fulfillment proof or separating roles from verdict.
units.risk: leadership, payment, Zion, temple, violence, history, later reuse, and fulfillment

units.title: Mountain, nations, instruction, and secure dwelling
units.literary_form: latter-days Zion oracle, nations dialogue, peace vision, and communal affirmation
units.deciding_marker: Latter-days frame moves from mountain and nations' speech through instruction and weapon transformation to dwelling and name-walk closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Isolating weapon transformation or deciding dependence, chronology, nation identity, or fulfillment.
units.risk: Isaiah parallel, dependence, nations, Zion, peace ethics, chronology, and fulfillment

units.title: Gathering the lame and restoring dominion
units.literary_form: in-that-day remnant-gathering and reign promise
units.deciding_marker: In-that-day gathers lame, outcast, and afflicted; remnant transformation advances to reign and former dominion.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting the group list or settling remnant, tower, kingdom, chronology, and fulfillment identities.
units.risk: disability imagery, remnant, Zion, kingship, chronology, and fulfillment

units.title: Daughter Zion's cry, labor, exile, and rescue
units.literary_form: rhetorical questions and labor-lament promise
units.deciding_marker: Now-why addresses daughter Zion; labor imperative moves through field and Babylon to there-rescue reversal.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating labor from rescue or fixing a single historical chronology.
units.risk: speaker, daughter-Zion metaphor, kingship, Babylon chronology, history, and fulfillment

units.title: Gathered nations become a threshing floor
units.literary_form: enemy-speech report, hidden-purpose reversal, and daughter-Zion threshing oracle
units.deciding_marker: Now-many-nations gather and speak; but-they-do-not-know reverses perspective, and arise-and-thresh closes the unit.
units.rejected_alternative: Atomizing nations or deciding divine causation, violence ethics, chronology, and fulfillment.
units.risk: nations, divine purpose, violence, conquest imagery, chronology, and fulfillment

units.title: Siege, Bethlehem ruler, gathering, shepherding, and peace
units.literary_form: siege summons and ruler-origin oracle with shepherd-king culmination
units.deciding_marker: Troop-gathering turns with but-you-Bethlehem; ruler emergence, giving-up, gathering, shepherding, greatness, and peace form one movement.
units.rejected_alternative: Extracting 5:2 or 5:4-5, preferring a versification or witness, or deciding ruler identity and fulfillment.
units.risk: versification, Bethlehem, ruler origin, birth imagery, identity, chronology, later reuse, and fulfillment

units.title: Seven shepherds and deliverance from Assyria
units.literary_form: conditional invasion-and-deliverance coda
units.deciding_marker: When-he-enters is answered by raised shepherds/leaders, shepherding by sword, and explicit deliverance.
units.rejected_alternative: Detaching the verse as numerical symbolism or settling leader identities, military ethics, chronology, and fulfillment.
units.risk: single-verse unit, numerical idiom, Assyria, leaders, violence, history, and fulfillment

units.title: The remnant as dew and lion
units.literary_form: paired remnant similes and victory wish
units.deciding_marker: The-remnant-shall-be frame balances dew/shower among peoples with lion imagery among nations and closes with exalted-hand wish.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating benign and violent similes or fixing remnant and enemy identities.
units.risk: remnant, nations, violence, identity, chronology, and fulfillment

units.title: In-that-day removal and vengeance
units.literary_form: purification-removal oracle with repeated cut-off formula
units.deciding_marker: In-that-day and repeated I-will-cut-off remove military, cities, sorceries, images, and poles before vengeance closure.
units.rejected_alternative: Atomizing the removal list or deciding cult history, violence ethics, divine action, or nation fulfillment.
units.risk: military power, cities, sorcery, images, worship, divine violence, nations, and fulfillment

units.title: Lawsuit summons and saving-history recital
units.literary_form: covenant-lawsuit summons, divine questions, and historical recital
units.deciding_marker: Hear-now calls mountains and foundations; my-people questions and remember recital run from exodus leaders through Balaam and crossing.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting the list into proof texts or deciding legal covenant system and historical reconstruction.
units.risk: lawsuit genre, covenant, exodus history, named figures, source relations, and theology

units.title: Escalating offering questions and the good response
units.literary_form: cultic disputation with escalating questions and concise answer
units.deciding_marker: With-what-shall-I-come grades offerings through firstborn; he-has-shown-you answers with justice, loyal love, and humble walking.
units.rejected_alternative: Detaching 6:8, preferring a lexical gloss, or deriving a complete sacrificial, ethical, or theological system.
units.risk: speaker, sacrifice, child offering, justice, hesed translation, walking idiom, ethics, and theology

units.title: The city voice, fraudulent measures, and desolation
units.literary_form: city summons, commercial indictment, futility curses, and historical comparison
units.deciding_marker: Voice-to-city and rod hearing lead through measure, violence, and deceit charges to illness, futility, royal comparison, and desolation.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting each measure or curse, or using royal names to settle date and historical setting.
units.risk: textual syntax, city identity, commerce, poverty, violence, royal history, curses, and chronology

units.title: Communal lament over vanished fidelity
units.literary_form: first-person communal lament, social indictment, and household breakdown catalogue
units.deciding_marker: Woe-is-me harvest simile opens lack; faithful-person disappearance expands through ambush, collusion, brier warning, and household distrust.
units.rejected_alternative: Atomizing social roles or fixing the first-person voice and historical crisis.
units.risk: communal speaker, social ethics, family relations, violence, watchmen, history, and later reuse

units.title: Watchful confession and address to the enemy
units.literary_form: confidence confession, fall-and-rise saying, sin acknowledgment, and enemy taunt
units.deciding_marker: But-as-for-me watch/wait answers lament; do-not-rejoice moves through darkness/light, borne indignation, vindication, and enemy shame.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating 7:7 from confession or assigning a certain individual, city, nation, chronology, and fulfillment.
units.risk: speaker, enemy identity, sin, divine anger, vindication, violence, chronology, and fulfillment

units.title: Building day, gathered peoples, and desolated land
units.literary_form: restoration-day oracle with geographic gathering and judgment qualification
units.deciding_marker: Building day and boundary extension lead through geographic pairs before yet-the-land-will-be-desolate qualifies the movement.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting the place list or resolving whose walls, land, peoples, geography, chronology, and fulfillment.
units.risk: speaker, city, geography, textual wording, nations, chronology, judgment, and fulfillment

units.title: Shepherd petition and exodus-like nations response
units.literary_form: pastoral prayer, divine answer, and nations' astonished submission
units.deciding_marker: Shepherd-your-people and pasture petition receive an as-in-exodus answer; nations see, weaken, enact dust imagery, and tremble.
units.rejected_alternative: Separating petition from answer and response or deciding speaker, remnant, exodus typology, nation identity, chronology, and fulfillment.
units.risk: shepherd, remnant, land, exodus, nations, fear, violence imagery, chronology, and fulfillment

units.title: Who-is-like closing hymn and ancestral oath
units.literary_form: doxological questions, mercy confession, and covenant-remembrance close
units.deciding_marker: Who-is-a-God-like-you echoes the book name; pardon, passing over, compassion, submerged sins, loyalty, and oath form the final hymn.
units.rejected_alternative: Detaching attributes or constructing a complete atonement, covenant, Israel/church, or fulfillment system.
units.risk: divine attributes, sin, remnant, hesed translation, ancestors, oath, covenant, theology, and fulfillment
